name: asset-sets-simple
description: IXT-SUITES simple rung for the `assetSets` flag (pro tier — 'Save groups as separate assets', Asset Studio Stage 3d, `furniture/glbEdit/setSplit.ts` + `ui/glbEditor/SavePanel.tsx`/`designerContext.tsx`). NOTE the parent-agent brief called this 'the Arrange Sets picker' but that's a different, already-ungated surface (`ArrangeMenu.tsx`'s 'Drop a set' / `userSets` flag) — `assetSets` actually gates a checkbox INSIDE the GLB designer's Save panel that additionally saves each top-level transform GROUP as its own standalone catalog asset. The whole designer dialog is Pro-only at the mount level (isPro gate, not a FEATURE_FLAGS entry) so the tier proof here is a direct `setFeatureFlag('assetSets', false/true)` override once already in Pro (mirrors the batch-9/10 'simple-tier -> setFeatureFlag proof' pattern for a flag whose parent surface is itself pro-gated). Real interaction: add two boxes, multi-select them, Group, toggle 'Save groups as separate assets' ONLY once the flag is back on, name + Save, and assert BOTH the combined asset AND the split-out 'Group 1' piece land in `state.userFurniture` (real `persistUserGlb` -> `addUserFurniture` round-trip, not a toast).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: wait-two-shapes
steps.failMessage: the 'Shapes' section header should appear once there are 2+ parts

steps.name: enter-select-mode
steps.eval: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button.chip')].find(x => x.textContent.trim() === 'Select'); if (!b) throw new Error('Select chip not found'); b.click(); })()

steps.name: wait-select-mode
steps.failMessage: multi-select mode should be active (chip reads 'Selecting…' / aria-pressed=true)

steps.name: assert-box-2-preselected
steps.comment: REAL app behaviour found while authoring this rung: the designer keeps a single-selection concept (`selId`) derived as the LAST id in the multi-select array `selIds` -- adding a new shape calls `setSelId(newId)` which REPLACES `selIds` with just that one id. So after adding box 1 then box 2, box 2 (the most-recently-added shape) is already the sole selection when 'Select' mode is toggled on -- its checkbox starts CHECKED. Clicking it again would toggle it OFF (an earlier draft of this scenario did exactly that and silently ended up with only box 1 selected). Assert the real starting state instead of assuming both start unchecked.
steps.eval: (() => { const b2 = document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Select box 2"]'); if (!b2) throw new Error('box 2 checkbox not found'); if (!b2.checked) throw new Error('expected box 2 (the last-added shape) to start pre-selected when entering multi-select mode') })()

steps.name: select-box-1
steps.comment: Only box 1 needs a click -- box 2 is already selected (see the assertion above). Clicking ADDS box 1 to the existing single-item selection, landing both selected without ever double-toggling box 2.
steps.eval: (() => { const b1 = document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Select box 1"]'); if (!b1) throw new Error('box 1 checkbox not found'); b1.click(); })()

steps.name: wait-box-1-checked
steps.failMessage: box 1's checkbox should be checked after clicking it

steps.name: assert-box-2-still-checked
steps.eval: (() => { const b2 = document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Select box 2"]'); if (!b2.checked) throw new Error('box 2 should remain selected after adding box 1 to the selection') })()

steps.name: wait-group-chip
steps.failMessage: the 'Group 2' chip should appear once 2 eligible parts are selected

steps.name: click-group
steps.eval: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button.chip')].find(x => x.textContent.trim().startsWith('Group ') && x.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Group selected shapes'); if (!b) throw new Error('Group chip not found'); b.click(); })()

steps.name: wait-group-created
steps.failMessage: grouping the two boxes should create a 'Group 1' transform group

steps.name: assert-split-toggle-hidden
steps.eval: (() => { if (document.body.textContent.includes('Save groups as separate assets')) throw new Error('assetSets=false should hide the split-groups toggle even with a real splittable group present') })()

steps.name: wait-split-toggle
steps.failMessage: assetSets=true should reveal the split-groups toggle (canSplitGroups = setsEnabled && !overwrite && hasSplittableGroups)

steps.name: enable-split-groups
steps.eval: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[aria-label="Save groups as separate assets"]'); if (!b) throw new Error('split-groups switch not found'); b.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-switch-on
steps.eval: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[aria-label="Save groups as separate assets"]'); if (b.getAttribute('aria-checked') !== 'true') throw new Error('split-groups switch did not turn on') })()

steps.name: set-asset-name
steps.eval: (function(){ const inp = document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Asset name"]'); if (!inp) throw new Error('asset name input missing'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(inp), 'value').set; setter.call(inp, 'IXT Set Combo'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.name: click-save
steps.comment: DOM .click() not the harness text-click — 'Save asset' is below the fold in the scrolling right panel (see the glb-designer-simple.json gotcha).
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Save asset' && !b.disabled); if (!btn) throw new Error('Save asset button not found or disabled'); btn.scrollIntoView(); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-combined-and-split-assets-saved

waitFor.store: state.userFurniture.length >= window.__glbBaseline + 2 && state.userFurniture.some(d => d.name === 'IXT Set Combo') && state.userFurniture.some(d => d.name === 'Group 1')

steps.failMessage: saving with 'Save groups as separate assets' on should add BOTH the combined 'IXT Set Combo' asset AND a standalone 'Group 1' asset to state.userFurniture
